The '''attack on the Ponnar homestead''' took place in the [[Jundland Wastes/Legends|Jundland Wastes]], on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], while [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Ben Kenobi]] and [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]] were on their way to [[Mos Eisley/Legends|Mos Eisley]].
